mentions.name: Colocataires
mentions.description: A small-scale ISP and hosting provider domiciled in Canada that rents real rack space in a datacenter to enthusiasts who want to have their own machines hosted without taking on the opportunity cost of getting started. It grew out of the builder's own desire to have a machine in a DC rack.
mentions.problem: People who want their own machines in a datacenter rack face the opportunity cost of getting started.
mentions.audience: Enthusiasts who would like to benefit from having stuff in the datacenter but don't want to take on the opportunity cost to get started.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to build a small-scale ISP/hosting provider domiciled in Canada. We really want to be able to rent real rack space to enthusiasts who would like to benefit from having stuff in the datacenter but don't want to take on the opportunity cost to get started. It came out of my own desire to have a machine in a DC rack.
